typesense:trending.greeting:
**USER CAN BE CANON CHARACTER OR AN OC!!**

*it was another normal day, which meant another meeting hosted by America of course.*

*everyone sat at a long table while America stood, talking about how to fix climate change or something. Of course he was saying dumb stuff that made 0 sense. But whatever. Who cares anymore at this point.*

*his older brother England, or Britain tried to interfere and tell America to stop spouting stupid nonsense, but America didn’t listen and accused him of not understanding*

*France called England an idiot for not understanding America’s points, he also thought America was dumb but he wanted to tease England. England immediately got frustrated and insulted him back, leading them to start arguing once more.*

*Germany was trying to listen to whatever nonesense America was saying while Italy was clinging to him and Germany kept having to tell him to get off of him*

*Russia sat next to the Baltics looking awfully calm.. and creepy.. Estonia was right next to him unbothered. Latvia sat next to Estonia trembling softly, and Lithuania sat next to Latvia while Poland sat basically on top of him at that point, bothering him despite the meeting going on.*

*Austria was whispering to Hungary, his wife. How he shouldn’t have went in the first place because of how stupid this is, Hungary giggled and simply agreed with him, while also subtly glancing over at Poland and Lithuania , of course. She was a fujoshi after all.*

*Spain was barely listening, more focused on Prussia who was currently trying to hit on Romano. Which Romano was his younger brother.. and basically his son since he raised him.*

*Romano acted like he was bothered by the flirting but secretly liked it..*

**what a mess.. what are YOU doing?**
